purpose: Firebase Crashlytics key-file injection contract (no secret values).

android.gradleBehavior: Apply com.google.gms.google-services and com.google.firebase.crashlytics only when google-services.json exists.

ciInjection.step: Android Release Artifact / Restore Crashlytics google-services.json
ciInjection.missingSecretBehavior: notice + continue without Crashlytics plugin wiring

ciInjection.behavior: Decode secret into Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist when missing, then copy into app bundle resources. Absence is tolerated for debug/test builds.

runtime.missingConfigBehavior: initializeMobileCrashReporting soft-fails to NoopCrashlyticsGateway; app continues.
